name: Briar Glen arrival
notes: The town end of the Miners' Bridge on the shop lane (scene briar-glen-lane, mw-e39.38). The first time the player steps off the bridge into Briar Glen the latch writes briar-glen.arrived = true and keeps it, so walking back over the bridge never undoes it. That fact starts the main quest (quest-labyrinth-beneath-briar-glen, bible 4.1 beat 1). The volume sits around the arrive-from-valley-03 spawn, so every arrival from the valley (and a debug load straight into the lane) starts the quest. Its node id is not an enterArea area of any quest: the lane is the town hub, and an area objective would be remembered by its early visits.
